text:
maya: Postmortem follow-up: compact action list for streaming/chat reliability (timeouts, partials, reconnects). Need owners + dates so we can schedule remediation sprint.

trent: I'll own client reconnect defaults + server handshake retry policy. Plan: RFC by 2026-03-25, SDK + runtime PRs by 2026-04-02, canary 2026-04-09. Default approach: exp backoff, cap attempts 5, small jitter.

sophia: Observability: add metric `stream.partial_rate` (by model+route), handshake latency histograms (p50/p95/p99), and an alert: sustained partial_rate > 0.5% over 10m OR instant spike >1%. Dashboard + runbook before canary. Target: 2026-03-27.

li: Repro harness owner. I'll build a deterministic replay that injects truncated chunks and network flaps, wire into nightly CI, and attach minimal repro to ticket. Target: 2026-03-24.

trent: Sample SDK config I'll propose (RFC):
```json
{"reconnect": {"enabled": true, "strategy": "exp", "initial_ms": 80, "max_ms": 1600, "max_attempts": 5, "jitter": 0.12}}
```
Feedback welcome.

ops-bot: Created tickets: RW-STREAM-950 (trent), RW-STREAM-951 (sophia), RW-STREAM-952 (li).

maya: Server-side short-circuit rule: if a request accumulates >N partial markers within a single session, mark `partial_shortcircuit=true`, invoke safe-fallback (no incremental retries), and persist KV snapshot to logs for 30s. Product comms draft required pre-canary.

sophia: Will tag logs with `event=partial_shortcircuit`, add trace span, and surface KV snapshot links on dashboard drilldown.

trent: Note: eng-runtime warned about reconnect storms starving continuous batching. I'll coordinate with them tomorrow and add a throttle guard in SDK if needed.

maya: Closure criteria: PRs merged, canary stable 48h with reduction in partial_rate vs baseline, telemetry retained 14d, retrospective then close actions. 15m sync Friday to confirm readiness.

li: ACK — attaching repro and nightly CI to RW-STREAM-952.

sophia: ACK — will link dashboard/runbook to RW-STREAM-951 before canary.

trent: ACK — RFC PR opening now and linking to RW-STREAM-950.

maya: Thanks everyone.
